description: A reviewed subset of the Level 1 recommendations expressible through configuration profiles. Controls that need filesystem state, audit configuration, or a DDM declaration stay listed as unmapped. This is not a reproduction of the benchmark text.

controls.title: Apple software current
controls.description: Keep macOS and Apple applications at the current supported release.
controls.note: This is an outcome rather than a switch. The update settings below implement the managed part of it.

controls.title: macOS update installation
controls.description: Install macOS updates when they are offered.

controls.title: App Store update installation
controls.description: Install application updates from the App Store automatically.

controls.title: Security responses
controls.description: Install security responses and system files automatically.

controls.title: Software update deferment
controls.note: The profile exposes a deferral delay, not a maximum deferral. Mattrax does not set a delay on the organisation's behalf.

controls.title: MDM management
controls.description: Confirm the Mac is enrolled in a management service.
controls.note: Enrolment is a device fact, not a policy value. Mattrax reports it from the device record.

controls.title: Application firewall
controls.description: Turn on the macOS application firewall.

controls.title: AirDrop
controls.description: Disable AirDrop when files are not actively being transferred.

controls.title: Automatic date and time
controls.description: Set the clock from the network automatically.

controls.title: Time service
controls.description: Keep the macOS time service enabled.
controls.note: The current catalogue does not expose a managed time-service switch.

controls.title: DVD and CD sharing
controls.note: The restrictions payload only exposes whether the user may change sharing settings, not whether the service runs.

controls.title: Screen sharing
controls.note: The restrictions payload only exposes whether the user may change sharing settings, not whether the service runs.

controls.title: File sharing
controls.note: The restrictions payload only exposes whether the user may change sharing settings, not whether the service runs.

controls.title: Printer sharing
controls.note: The restrictions payload only exposes whether the user may change sharing settings, not whether the service runs.

controls.title: Remote login
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose the remote-login service switch.

controls.title: Remote management
controls.note: The restrictions payload only exposes whether the user may change the setting, not whether the service runs.

controls.title: Remote Apple Events
controls.note: The restrictions payload only exposes whether the user may change the setting, not whether the service runs.

controls.title: Internet sharing
controls.note: The restrictions payload only exposes whether the user may change the setting, not whether the service runs.

controls.title: Bluetooth sharing
controls.note: The restrictions payload only exposes whether the user may change the setting, not whether the service runs.

controls.title: Time Machine encryption
controls.description: Encrypt Time Machine volumes when Time Machine is in use.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose Time Machine volume encryption.

controls.title: Wi-Fi menu bar status
controls.description: Show Wi-Fi status in the menu bar.

controls.title: Bluetooth menu bar status
controls.description: Show Bluetooth status in the menu bar.

controls.title: Siri settings audit
controls.description: Review the Siri configuration on the device.
controls.note: This is an audit recommendation with no single managed value.

controls.title: Siri and dictation improvement
controls.description: Stop sharing Siri and dictation data.
controls.note: The catalogue exposes the Assistant content-sharing restriction; macOS has no separate managed switch for this programme.

controls.title: Assistive voice improvement
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose this analytics programme.

controls.title: App developer analytics
controls.description: Stop sharing analytics with app developers.
controls.note: The diagnostic-submission restriction also covers app developer analytics.

controls.title: iCloud analytics
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose a separate iCloud analytics switch.

controls.title: Gatekeeper
controls.description: Require Gatekeeper assessment and allow identified developers.

controls.title: System-wide preference changes
controls.description: Require an administrator password to change system-wide preferences.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose this authorisation behaviour.

controls.title: Universal Control
controls.note: This is an audit recommendation with no single managed value.

controls.title: Power Nap
controls.description: Disable Power Nap on Intel Macs.
controls.note: The catalogue's energy-saver payload is not exposed under an unambiguous collection id.

controls.title: Wake for network access
controls.note: The catalogue's energy-saver payload is not exposed under an unambiguous collection id.

controls.title: Screen saver inactivity
controls.description: Start the screen saver after 20 minutes or less of inactivity.

controls.title: Screen saver password
controls.description: Require a password within five seconds of the screen saver starting.

controls.title: Login screen message
controls.description: Show a custom message on the login screen.
controls.note: The message is organisation-specific, so the template cannot choose its wording.

controls.title: Login window style
controls.description: Show the login window as name and password fields.

controls.title: Password hints
controls.description: Do not show password hints after failed attempts.

controls.title: Account password hints
controls.description: Ensure individual accounts have no password hint.
controls.note: Hints are stored per user account; the catalogue has no managed setting for them.

controls.title: Touch ID
controls.note: This is an audit recommendation with no single managed value.

controls.title: Guest account
controls.note: The guest account payload shares a collection id with several other MCX payloads, so the designer cannot address it unambiguously.

controls.title: Guest shared folders
controls.description: Disable guest access to shared folders.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose guest share access.

controls.title: Automatic login
controls.note: DisableFDEAutoLogin only covers the FileVault login path, so it is not a complete mapping.

controls.title: Passwords preference
controls.note: This is an audit recommendation with no single managed value.

controls.title: Notification and Focus
controls.note: This is an audit recommendation with no single managed value.

controls.title: Internet accounts
controls.note: This is an audit recommendation with no single managed value.

controls.title: On-device dictation
controls.description: Enable dictation while keeping processing on the device.

controls.title: Security auditing
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose the audit daemon configuration.

controls.title: install.log retention
controls.description: Retain install.log for at least 365 days.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose log retention.

controls.title: Audit retention
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose audit retention.

controls.title: Audit record access
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose audit file permissions.

controls.title: HTTP server
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose the web server service.

controls.title: NFS server
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose the NFS service.

controls.title: Home folder permissions
controls.description: Keep home folders private to their owners.
controls.note: Home folder ACLs are not a managed profile setting.

controls.title: System Integrity Protection
controls.note: SIP is not configurable through a configuration profile.

controls.title: Apple Mobile File Integrity
controls.note: AMFI is not configurable through a configuration profile.

controls.title: Signed System Volume
controls.note: SSV is a property of the installed OS, not a managed setting.

controls.title: System application permissions
controls.note: This is a filesystem audit with no managed setting.

controls.title: World-writable system folders
controls.description: Ensure no world-writable folders exist in the System folder.
controls.note: This is a filesystem audit with no managed setting.

controls.title: World-writable Library folders
controls.description: Ensure no world-writable folders exist in the Library folder.
controls.note: This is a filesystem audit with no managed setting.

controls.title: Password lockout threshold
controls.description: Lock an account after five failed password attempts.

controls.title: Minimum password length
controls.description: Require at least 15 characters and enforce the password policy.

controls.title: Password history
controls.description: Keep 24 previous passwords out of reuse.

controls.title: APFS user volume encryption
controls.note: FileVault encrypts the APFS volume that holds user data.

controls.title: CoreStorage volume encryption
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose CoreStorage volume encryption.

controls.title: Sudo timeout
controls.description: Set the sudo timeout to zero.
controls.note: Sudoers is not a managed profile setting.

controls.title: Per-tty timestamps
controls.description: Use a separate timestamp for each user and terminal.
controls.note: Sudoers is not a managed profile setting.

controls.title: Locked session login
controls.description: Stop administrators logging into another user's locked session.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose this login-window behaviour.

controls.title: Guest home folder
controls.note: This is a filesystem state, not a managed profile setting.

controls.title: XProtect
controls.note: XProtect updates are managed by macOS, not by a configuration profile.

controls.title: Sudo logging
controls.note: Sudoers is not a managed profile setting.

controls.title: Filename extensions
controls.description: Show all filename extensions in Finder.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose the Finder extension preference.

controls.title: Safari safe files
controls.description: Disable automatic opening of safe files in Safari.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose this Safari preference as a profile payload.

controls.title: Safari fraud warning
controls.description: Warn when Safari visits a suspected fraudulent website.

controls.title: Safari cross-site tracking
controls.note: Safari privacy settings are DDM declarations; this profile template does not mix profiles and declarations.

controls.title: Safari advertising privacy
controls.note: Safari privacy settings are DDM declarations; this profile template does not mix profiles and declarations.

controls.title: Safari full website address
controls.description: Show the full website address in Safari.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose this Safari preference as a profile payload.

controls.title: Safari pop-up windows
controls.note: This is an audit recommendation with no single managed value.

controls.title: Safari status bar
controls.description: Show the status bar in Safari.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose this Safari preference as a profile payload.

controls.title: Terminal secure keyboard entry
controls.description: Enable secure keyboard entry in Terminal.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose this Terminal preference.
